explain_task.question: In the revised model, use `src/current_heuristic.py`, `src/formulation.tex`, and the revised LP-relaxation output to diagnose which business rule is actually limiting the maximum `dual_match_count = 5500`. Identify one binding demand or supply relation and one nonbinding relation by naming the exact code expression/variable(s), the exact CSV columns and parameter value(s) they come from, and the corresponding business term in `docs/business_requirement.md`; then explain the business meaning of the marginal value using at least one reported reduced cost or zero-slack assignment pattern from the LP relaxation. Finally, compare original vs revised and pinpoint the exact code additions/deletions that changed the objective from minimizing `d3_minus2` to maximizing `dual_match_count`, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate that a +1 change in `priority_2_target` or a single-demand-cell `Demand` value would change the 5500 objective by a constant amount.
